mechanics.name: Parental Guidance
mechanics.currentEffect: After stunning the Killer by any means, suppresses your Grunts of Pain, Scratch Marks, and Pools of Blood for 5/6/7 seconds.
activation: Stun the Killer by any means.
Ends/deactivates when: The suppression ends after 5/6/7 seconds.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Stunning the Killer briefly hides your pain sounds and tracking traces.
duration: Grunts of Pain, Scratch Marks, and Pools of Blood suppression: 5/6/7 seconds.

editorial.summary: After stunning the Killer by any means, hide your Grunts of Pain, Scratch Marks, and Blood for 7 seconds.
useCases: Turn a pallet or Head On stun into a complete tracking break.
Use the seven-second suppression window to change direction after line of sight is lost.
Pair repeated stun tools with stealth-focused chase builds.
counters: Direct vision and Aura reading still reveal you.
Seven seconds disappears quickly if the tile has no branching routes.
pros: Suppresses three important tracking channels simultaneously.
Works after any Killer stun, not just pallets.
Can convert a successful stun into an actual chase escape.
cons: No raw Haste or health-state protection.
analysis: Parental Guidance ranks this position because seven seconds without pain sounds, Scratch Marks, or Blood is enough to create a serious tracking problem after a stun. The Killer is already losing time to the stun animation, which gives the Survivor a natural window to break line of sight.

The perk is especially effective with Head On and Smash Hit. One creates a reliable Locker stun opportunity, while the other can add immediate distance after a pallet stun. Parental Guidance then removes the trail that would normally tell the Killer where that distance went.

The ceiling depends on geometry. A Survivor who runs straight down an open lane remains visible regardless of the hidden tracking cues. Dense structures and branching paths are where the suppression actually becomes threatening.
That makes the perk a useful high-skill chase tool. It can turn one won interaction into a complete escape, but it cannot guarantee the stun or the route afterward.
editorial.verdict: A strong stun-to-stealth converter. Parental Guidance is excellent when you can break line of sight immediately after the Killer loses control of the chase.
